# Vulpkanin
## General Information
Vulpkanin have sharp claws, and their unarmed attacks deal Slash damage rather than Blunt.
Their animal-like digestive system can process raw meat and blood without ill effects, but is poisoned by allicin (found in garlic and onions) and theobromine (found in caffeinated beverages and chocolate).
Their shape of their muzzle makes drinking difficult, and they tend to spill whatever they're drinking on the ground.
They take [color=#1e90ff]15% less Cold damage[/color], but [color=#ffa500]15% more Heat damage[/color] than most species. Their dense fur makes them prefer cooler temperatures than humans, and also makes them [color=#ffa500]extremely vulnerable to fire[/color].
## Leaping
Vulpkanins' digitigrade legs allow them to leap impressive distances. This is useful for jumping over ground-based hazards (such as bottomless chasms), or for a quick burst of speed to escape a dangerous situation or chase someone down.
Be careful not to crash into anything mid-leap, or you'll fall to the ground and drop what you're holding!
